A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.
Next, I'll compare per-service span counts, error rates and mean latency between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: Checkout's client and server spans all error in the abnormal period, while most other services look normal. Next I'll look at checkout's error spans and what they call.

input.query: SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, attr_status_code, attr_http_response_status_code, attr_k8s_pod_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('checkout','frontend','frontend-proxy','cart','payment','currency','shipping','email','quote') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

content.text: Cart's restart counter climbs from 0 to 1 early in the window and then stays there, and checkout's `GetCart` calls fail in under a millisecond. Next I'll check uptime across pods and whether cart emits any spans or metrics after the restart.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' p, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, metric, count(*) n, round(min(value),1) mn, round(max(value),1) mx, epoch(min(time)) t0, epoch(max(time)) t1 FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', attr_k8s_pod_name, metric, count(*), round(min(value),1), round(max(value),1), epoch(min(time)), epoch(max(time)) FROM normal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1
SELECT 'abn' p, min(epoch(time)) t0, max(epoch(time)) t1 FROM abnormal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', min(epoch(time)), max(epoch(time)) FROM normal_traces

content.text: Cart's pod metrics (CPU, network I/O, uptime) continue through the window, but it emits no server spans. That looks more like a connection-level cut between callers and cart than a crashed pod. I'll check the per-connection `hubble_*` metrics for traffic to and from cart.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' p, metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*) n, round(sum(value),1) total FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, attr_source, attr_destination, count(*), round(sum(value),1) FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric LIKE 'hubble%' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,4,1

content.text: The telemetry points to one root cause, the cart service's pod, which dropped out after a restart and stayed unreachable. Before writing up, I'll run one confirming query on cart's span counts and checkout's failed `GetCart` calls.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, (SELECT count(*) FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='cart') cart_spans, (SELECT count(*) FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='checkout' AND span_name='oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' AND attr_status_code='Error') checkout_getcart_err UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', (SELECT count(*) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='cart'), (SELECT count(*) FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='checkout' AND span_name='oteldemo.CartService/GetCart' AND attr_status_code='Error')

input.reflection: Findings: cart emitted 448 spans in normal and 0 in abnormal. Its pod restart counter went 0->1 about 10s into the abnormal window. Checkout GetCart client calls (22) all fail in ~0.1ms, and frontend CartService calls (AddItem 71, GetCart 35) also fail fast. Errors propagate: checkout PlaceOrder server errors -> frontend /api/checkout and POST /api/cart 500s -> frontend-proxy ingress 500s (156, matching frontend-proxy router egress errors). No hubble network metrics exist, logs are empty. Other services (payment, shipping, currency, email) are absent only because checkout failed before calling them. Conclusion: a single root cause at cart; the cart pod went away after restart and never returned spans, so pod_unavailable (equivalent to pod_failure).
